title: 阿利斯塔·山口守望
description: 紫色牛头阿利斯塔沉稳立于山口，双臂自然下垂，厚实衣甲、奶白双角与远山形成雄健剪影。

art_direction.medium: angular wax-crayon strokes, directional hatching and dramatic hard-edged light on textured paper
art_direction.identity: Alistar is a massive purple minotaur with broad cream horns, a heavy bovine muzzle, pointed ears, a dark mane, huge hands, and cloven hooves. Preserve his nonhuman head and powerful bull-like adult build without frightening teeth. Cover his humanoid torso in a substantial sleeved work tunic and armored vest, with a belted opaque lower wrap and leg coverings.
art_direction.scene: Place him motionless at a wide mountain pass with both hooves firmly on stone and arms relaxed beside his body. His head turns slightly toward a distant valley, giving the posture dignity rather than aggression. A single monumental rock face catches sharp side light; coarse wax layers separate purple planes from pale mist and angular mountain silhouettes.
art_direction.palette: deep purple, horn ivory, slate blue, warm ochre
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
